item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Morning Video Frame Thumbnail

turns.text: Use a clear frame from my video to make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Keep me recognisable and add “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. Pick the frame yourself; make it warm and upbeat.

item.tests: Tests extracting a usable frame from an attached video and composing it with readable text into a still thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Source and frame selection: Use talk-one.mp4; pick a clear frame yourself.
answer_sheet.Person: The woman speaking at the kitchen table in the attached video; keep her recognisable.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm and upbeat, with big text beside my face; colours and font are your call.

must_haves: The deliverable is one still image in 16:9, not a video.
The thumbnail visibly uses a frame from talk-one.mp4, retaining the woman's identity and source-frame appearance.
The woman's face is clear and unobstructed.
The headline reads exactly “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in large, legible letters beside her face.
The overall treatment looks warm and upbeat.

turns.text: Use a clear frame from the attached clip to make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Keep me recognisable and add “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. Pick the frame yourself; make it warm and upbeat. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**The lowest-cost AI option starts at 5 credits**: one 16:9 image edited with Flux 2 Klein at **640px** on your free plan. I haven’t started anything.

| Step | Credit cost |
|---|---:|
| Extract a video frame | 0 |
| Make one thumbnail at 640px | From 5 |
| Additional versions or AI upscaling | Extra—skip these |

I’d preserve your facial features, use warm, upbeat lighting, and place **“MORNINGS MADE EASY”** in large letters beside your face. AI-generated lettering and likeness can need corrections; I wouldn’t automatically spend credits on retries.

**Cheaper options**
- **0 credits:** extract a still and add the title in a regular image editor. This also gives you exact, reliable lettering.
- **Smallest AI option:** one 640px image, no variations or upscale. It’s below YouTube’s recommended 1280×720.
- **Shorter won’t save credits:** we’re editing one still, not generating video, so clip length doesn’t affect that image-edit cost.

One limitation: my available frame-extraction tool takes **only the last frame**, so I can’t honestly pick the clearest frame from the whole clip here. I can extract that frame for free and check whether it’s suitable, or you can supply a clear screenshot.

**Shall I extract and check the last frame first, with no paid generation yet?** I can’t verify an exact account-specific charge with the tools available, so the 5-credit figure is a starting price, not a guaranteed quote.

The free extraction failed: the tool accepts a video URL or finished project ID, but couldn’t read the attached file’s storage path. **No generation ran or credits were spent.**

Please attach a clear screenshot from the clip, or provide a direct downloadable video URL so I can try extracting the last frame. I’ll check the still before starting any paid edit.
dialog.user: Please use talk-one.mp4 and pick a clear frame yourself; I don’t have a screenshot or direct download URL to provide.

dialog.agent:
I understand—you want me to choose the frame from **talk-one.mp4**, not ask you to do it.

Unfortunately, the connected tools can’t extract or browse frames from this attachment’s storage path. The only frame-extraction tool accepts a public video URL or a completed Magic Hour project ID, and the attempt with your attachment failed. I should have caught that limitation before offering.

**No credits have been spent.** I can’t complete the frame selection with the tools currently available, and I won’t run a paid video conversion or recreate your face just to work around that limitation.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The cheapest option I listed was **0 credits: use a frame from your clip and add the title in a regular image editor**. I’m sorry—I shouldn’t have offered that as something I could complete here, because these tools can’t extract a usable frame from your attached MP4 or add text manually.

The **AI option starts at 5 credits**, but it also needs a still image first. Your approval doesn’t resolve that technical block, so I haven’t started a paid job or spent any credits.
